_note: Structured content for the home, Research, Resume and Teaching pages. career: roles in chronological order (the phone timeline uses this order); band/col/row place them in the two-row desktop flow on the Resume page; cat is edu, ind, acad or res (industry + academic research); teach adds a teaching badge. milestones: the short career strip on the home page. stats: figures that cannot be counted from other data files (publication, citation and repository counts are computed); top_venues are named on the home publications tile and must each match the short name of at least one paper in publications.json. themes and applications: each item lists the start of one or more publication titles from publications.json; the build links every one to that paper on the Publications page and stops with an error if a title does not match exactly one paper. Projects join an application through their domain in projects.json. Theme and application figures: img is relative to assets/img/ (svg names a file in assets/svg/); paper links the caption to that publication. recognition: the Awards and recognition list on the home page, newest first; paper links an item to that publication.

items.t: Short-term load forecasting for smart grids

figures.alt: Forecasting pipeline: historical load and meteorological data are decomposed with a best-basis stationary wavelet packet transform, forecast by parallel HHO-FNN models and reconstructed into a day-ahead load forecast
figures.caption: Wavelet decomposition and HHO-FNN models for day-ahead load forecasting.

figures.alt: Day-ahead load forecast for a summer working day: actual load plotted against the proposed method and three baselines, PSO-ANN, PSO-LSSVM and BPNN
figures.caption: Forecast against actual load on a summer working day.

figures.alt: Device fingerprinting process: traffic capture, feature extraction, preprocessing, fingerprint generation, sampling into training and testing data, model training, evaluation and device classification
figures.caption: Identifying IoT devices from their network traffic.
